title: Operador Loja
description:
Faça parte do crescimento do Assaí! Com lojas espalhadas por todo Brasil com um time diverso de + 80 mil colaboradores, vivemos com paixão para atender os(as) nossos(as) clientes. Somos reconhecidos como um excelente lugar para se trabalhar, proporcionando um ambiente acolhedor, diversificado e propício ao crescimento.

Responsabilidades
  • Manter as gôndolas abastecidas e limpas;
  • Assegurar que as mercadorias estejam precificadas, organizadas e seguras;
  • Verificar data de validade e organizar os produtos;
  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes;
  • Efetuar a limpeza dos balcões, gôndolas e produtos;
  • Participar da realização dos inventários periódicos da seção;
  • Podem atuar nas áreas: Hortifruti, Laticínios, Frios/Embutidos/Seca Doce/Seca Salgada/Bebidas/Bazar/Depósito.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica mínima: Ensino Médio Completo.

Faixa etária: mínimo 18 anos.

Experiência: não é necessário experiência na função.

Benefícios
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Cartão Cesta Básica
  • Refeição no local de trabalho
  • Extensão da Licença Maternidade
  • Enxoval do Bebê
  • Plano de Carreira

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de tradição? Considerada a marca mais valiosa do varejo alimentar segundo os rankings de 2025 da Interbrand, Brand Finance e TM20 /Infomoney.

Mas primeiro, deixa a gente se apresentar: somos o Assaí Atacadista e estamos em busca de profissionais como você! Queremos fortalecer ainda mais a Nossa Gente, composta por cerca de 88 mil colaboradores(as) , distribuídos por nossos escritórios, CDs e mais de 300 lojas.

É muita coisa, não é mesmo? Mas pode ter certeza de que aqui nós olhamos para cada pessoa, enxergando e valorizando suas particularidades e respeitando as diferenças, pois acreditamos no poder da Diversidade e da Inclusão !

Essa é uma frente muito importante para nós e, por isso, somos signatários da Iniciativa Empresarial pela Igualdade Racial e aderimos oSelo “Sim a Igualdade Racial” , além de outros compromissos como Movimento Mulher 360 , Princípios de Empoderamento da Mulher da ONU (WEPs) , Coalizão Empresarial pelo Fim da Violência Contra Mulheres e Meninas , Fórum de Empresas e Direitos LGBTI+ , Rede Empresarial pela Igualdade Social e Fórum Empresas com Refugiados (ACNUR) , que fortalecem nossas ações e impactam para gerar transformações na sociedade.

Fazemos questão de promover, dia a dia, um ambiente onde todos e todas se sintam bem e felizes, e não é à toa que o principal valor da nossa cultura é o ‘Cuidado com a Nossa Gente’. Por isso também, estamos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar do Varejo, segundo o ranking da GPTW.

Ficou com vontade de fazer parte desse time? Uma coisa a gente garante: o que não falta por aqui é ‘Paixão pelo que fazemos’ , e você vai sentir isso em cada etapa do nosso negócio, na entrega e na dedicação de todas as nossas pessoas. Simplesmente, porque Ser Assaí é Assim.

Engenheiro de Segurança de Processos Sr. - RIO00E1

Primary Location

BRA-RDJ-Rio de Janeiro

Construindo sobre nosso passado. Prontos para o futuro

A Worley é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais composta por especialistas em energia, produtos químicos e recursos. Estabelecemos parcerias com clientes para entregar projetos e criar valor ao longo da vida de seus ativos. Estamos a unir dois mundos, avançando em direção a fontes de energia mais sustentáveis, ao mesmo tempo que ajudamos a fornecer a energia, os produtos químicos e os recursos necessários agora.

Seja qual for a sua ambição, há um caminho para você aqui. E não há barreira para o sucesso potencial de sua carreira. Para obter mais informações, visite Worley.com.

Estamos buscando pum(a) Engenheiro(a) de Segurança de Processos Sr. para atuar em projetos de óleo & gás, com foco em engenharia executiva e detalhada em refinarias, plantas químicas e unidades industriais.

Requisitos
  • Formação Acadêmica em Engenharia Química, de Processos ou correlata (CREA ativo).
  • Experiência sólida em Segurança de Processos em projetos industriais de óleo & gás.
  • Experiência em engenharia de incêndio e normas aplicáveis.
  • Conhecimento de normas e boas práticas internacionais (API, NFPA, OSHA, IEC 61511, CCPS).
  • Conhecimento das Instruções Técnicas dos Corpos de Bombeiros dos estados do Pará, Minas Gerais, São Paulo e Ceará.
  • Treinamento em regulamentações locais de combate a incêndio.
  • Experiência em análise de riscos (HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, BowTie, What-if).
  • Inglês avançado (requerido, com foco em leitura técnica, relatórios e comunicação).
  • Desejável experiência em segurança ocupacional.
  • Domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Desejável experiência com softwares de simulação e análise de riscos (PHA-Pro, PHAWorks, Safeti, entre outros).
Habilidades
  • Forte capacidade de integração com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Liderança técnica e suporte a decisões de projeto.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes de alta criticidade e conformidade com SMS/QSMS.
Responsabilidades
  • Conduzir e participar de estudos de análise e gerenciamento de riscos (HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, etc.).
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar documentação técnica de segurança de processos e incêndio.
  • Garantir conformidade de projetos com normas internacionais, regulatórias locais e requisitos do cliente.
  • Apoiar a integração das disciplinas de engenharia com foco em soluções seguras.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico em reuniões de projeto, revisões de segurança e interfaces com clientes e órgãos reguladores.
  • Avaliar medidas de mitigação de riscos e propor salvaguardas adequadas.
  • Apoiar a equipe de construção e comissionamento em temas relacionados à segurança de processos.
  • Promover cultura de segurança em todas as fases do projeto.

Localidade: Rio de Janeiro, RJ (Presencial)

Avançando juntos

Estamos empenhados em construir um local de trabalho diversificado, inclusivo e respeitoso, onde todos sintam que pertencem, possam falar e sejam ouvidos.

Estamos construindo um local de trabalho diversificado, inclusivo e respeitoso. Criar um espaço onde todos sintam que pertencem, possam ser eles mesmos e sejam ouvidos.

E não estamos apenas falando sobre isso; estamos fazendo isso.

description:
Você é organizado(a), proativo(a) e tem paixão por apoiar a gestão de pessoas? Quer fazer parte de uma equipe comprometida com o bem-estar das pessoas? O Vita Check-up está procurando por você!

Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador de Recursos Humanos Pleno para atuar em nossa clínica ambulatorial. Este profissional será responsável por executar e aprimorar os processos de RH, garantindo a gestão eficiente de pessoas e alinhando as práticas da área às necessidades do negócio assessorando a Diretoria de RH e com atenção aos compromissos e demandas diárias.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Recrutamento e Seleção:

Conduzir processos seletivos, desde a divulgação de vagas até a admissão de novos colaboradores.

Garantir o onboarding de novos funcionários e o alinhamento cultural.

2. Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:

Identificar necessidades de capacitação e planejar ações de treinamento.

Implementar e acompanhar programas de desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

3. Gestão de Pessoal:

Realizar a gestão de ponto eletrônico e fechamento de folha de pagamento em parceria com a contabilidade terceirizada.

Controlar benefícios como vale-transporte, vale-refeição e planos de saúde.

4. Gestão de Desempenho:

Acompanhar avaliações de desempenho e propor ações de melhoria.

Desenvolver planos de sucessão e retenção de talentos.

5. Clima Organizacional:

Implementar pesquisas de clima e propor ações para melhorar a satisfação e engajamento dos colaboradores.

Organizar eventos internos que promovam a integração e a motivação da equipe.

description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

ATIVIDADES

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.

Intervenção

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. A Ortobom iniciou suas atividades em 1969, fabricando camas e mesas de metal. Atenta às novas tendências, a empresa passou a comprar blocos de espuma para a confecção de colchões, que harmoniosamente se casavam com as camas.

Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes.

O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis.

A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo.

A qualidade é garantida através de um investimento constante em tecnologia, desde a matéria-prima ao maquinário. Toda essa estrutura só é possível graças ao potencial humano: são mais de 6.000 colaboradores, 1.000 franqueados e 5.000 consultores em todo o Brasil.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

description:
Coordenador(a) de Riscos Cibernéticos – Globo – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Compreender como os diferentes riscos cibernéticos podem afetar as operações da Globo, priorizando os esforços para proteger os aspectos mais vitais do negócio e minimizar possíveis interrupções, violações de dados, não conformidade, penalidades financeiras ou impactos na marca e/ou reputação;
  • Avaliar o impacto potencial dos riscos de segurança cibernética nos processos e funções críticas do negócio;
  • Avaliar a relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação as possíveis perdas, ponderando as despesas com a implementação de controles de segurança em relação ao impacto financeiro e operacional de um incidente de segurança, otimizando a alocação de recursos para alcançar a máxima eficiência na redução de risco;
  • Alinhar a gestão de riscos cibernéticos com os objetivos do negócio, compreendendo os objetivos estratégicos e garantindo que as medidas de segurança cibernética sejam integradas de forma harmoniosa;
  • Coordenar a identificação e classificação dos riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e os impactos desses riscos;
  • Coordenar a coleta de dados de avaliação de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e realizar avaliações de riscos de segurança cibernética para terceiros críticos, conforme necessário;
  • Implementar e evoluir com o sistema de monitoramento e gerenciamento de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros, conforme definido nos contratos com terceiros e de acordo com Política de Segurança da Informação para Fornecedores;
  • Construir planos de remediação, colaborando com as demais lideranças da empresa para alcançar um equilíbrio entre os requisitos de segurança e a necessidade de agilidade, inovação e crescimento do negócio, assegurando que as ferramentas de segurança ou outros controles compensatórios sugeridos reduzam o risco identificado para um nível aceitável;
  • Fornecer treinamento/orientação às partes interessadas em toda a Globo para promover uma forte cultura de conscientização sobre riscos.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Bacharelado em: Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em auditoria de TI, gestão de riscos corporativos (ERM) ou gestão de riscos cibernéticos;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em identificar e avaliar riscos para os negócios da organização, estruturas de gestão de riscos e estruturas de gestão de segurança da informação, com foco na priorização de esforços para proteger aspectos vitais e minimizar interrupções;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos dos padrões de segurança cibernética, incluindo, mas não se limitando ISO 27005, OpenFAIR, NIST RMF, IRAM, TOGAF, NIST CSF e ISO/IEC 27001;
  • Histórico comprovado na realização de Análises de Custo-Benefício de Medidas de Segurança, incluindo a avaliação da relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação a potenciais perdas comerciais;
  • Experiência com princípios e práticas de segurança cibernética, incluindo gerenciamento de riscos, controles de segurança e continuidade de negócios, entre eles a ISO 22301, Práticas Profissionais do Disaster Recovery Institute (DRI) e a elaboração de Análise de Impacto no Negócio (BIA);
  • Experiência comprovada na integração da gestão de riscos de segurança cibernética com a estratégia geral de negócios, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Experiência com auditorias de conformidade, segurança e planos de mitigação de riscos;
  • Amplo conhecimento dos conceitos de gestão de riscos e governança de segurança cibernética de terceiros;
  • Experiência na avaliação de riscos de terceiros, condução e resposta a procedimentos de due dilligence e na criação de questionários para avaliação de riscos cibernético de terceiros para terceiros empresariais;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar efetivamente os outros, modificando opiniões, planos ou comportamentos de forma estruturada e eficiente com base nos dados e fatos analisados;
  • Domínio de técnicas de apresentação, possibilitando a construção de narrativas e histórias através de apresentações;
  • Experiência em influenciar terceiros e gerenciar relacionamentos com terceiros;
  • Conhecimento de métodos analíticos e proficiência em análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias e ferramentas (por exemplo: serviços de classificação financeira, serviços de classificação de segurança, plataformas integradas de gerenciamento de risco, plataformas de gerenciamento de risco de terceiros, etc.) que auxiliarão na avaliação do risco financeiro e operacional associado a fornecedores atuais e potenciais.
Conhecimentos que te destacam
  • Certificações de gestão de riscos e segurança da informação como: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA) ou Open FAIR Part-1.

  • Agir proativamente para resguardar a MODEC do descumprimento aos requisitos legais/regulatórios e normas técnicas, atendendo a todas as especificações e procedimentos técnicos relacionados à disciplina de Instrumentação, participando em auditorias internas/externas e criando planos de ação para corrigir não conformidades.

Aprovar tecnicamente prorrogações contratuais e ser o responsável pelo fornecedor contratado acompanhando o planejamento, execução e encerramento do serviço e aprovação de relatórios e BMs.
  • Melhorar a qualidade dos processos relacionados à manutenção corretiva/preventiva e sua execução, realizando avaliação técnica com base em procedimentos e padrões e implementando estratégias e práticas de manutenção, incluindo planejamento e execução de fluxos de trabalho, a serem utilizados em toda a Frota, seguindo procedimentos corporativos e se comunicando com o Comitê de Manutenção e os principais stakeholders (Equipes de Operação e Times Offshore).

  • Conhecer, reforçar e garantir o pleno cumprimento dos requisitos corporativos para a segurança nas instalações e serviços, NR-10, NR-13, NR-30, NR-37, ABNT NBR IEC 60079, ANSI/ISA 5.1, outros requisitos estatutários, regulatórios, de bandeira e de classe relacionados.
  • Garantir a integridade e investigar falhas e incidentes em Instrumentos, Sensores, Válvulas de Controle/Instrumentadas, Sistemas de Monitoramento Ambiental, de Movimento e Oceanográficos e outros equipamentos relacionados à disciplina, embarcando nas unidades offshore sempre que necessário, realizando análise de causa raiz, elaborando pacotes de trabalho, relatórios técnicos, documentações e procedimentos de manutenção, com anotação de responsabilidade técnica.
  • Assegurar o máximo de conformidade aos requisitos legais/regulatórios e às normas técnicas de HSSEQ, embarcando para investigação e suporte técnico para Acidentes & Incidentes de HSSE que não estejam relacionados à manutenção, quando necessário.

  • Apoiar o planejamento orçamentário anual corporativo da MdB de despesas e investimentos para os Sistemas de Instrumentação, fornecendo informações baseadas em experiências anteriores, histórico de manutenção, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas do mercado e mapeando os possíveis riscos envolvidos para apoiar as decisões de gestão.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua do IMS, acompanhando e preenchendo o status dos projetos e monitorando a implementação e atualizando os documentos do IMS sob a responsabilidade da Disciplina de Instrumentação.

As a Data Scientist, you’re expected to

title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead Manager, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About the Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?:

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top-line numbers every month.

  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols

  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort-level experiment tracking

  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.
What you will do (Key Responsibilities):
  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR-vs-retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort-level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity
Our Tech Stack:
  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event-sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI-assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding
What we are looking for (Qualifications):
  • You've led a team of 4-8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You've shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade-offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You're comfortable with event-sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team's development process
Nice to have (strongly preferred):
  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure
How we work:
  • Remote, Americas-based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two-week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day
World-Class Benefits:
  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada)
  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)
Interview process

Do you believe you're a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We'd love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

Please refrain from messaging or emailing people directly, if you are interested, apply directly, your application will be reviewed by a human.

  1. Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  2. First Interview (30min): Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be a exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60min): You will then meet with Mark P - Head of Engineering to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design and technical decisions as well as discussion about leading a team, growing engineers, hiring, AI adoption, and other aspects of people leadership.
  4. Technical Interview (60min): Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands-on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate.
  5. Product Interview (45min): You will chat with Steve C - Senior Growth Product Manager who will dive into your collaboration with product, how you assess tradeoffs, and growth related product work.
  6. Meet the CEO (30min): At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus's strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

description:

Descrição da vaga

JOB DESCRIPTION

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Compreender como os diferentes riscos cibernéticos podem afetar as operações da Globo, priorizando os esforços para proteger os aspectos mais vitais do negócio e minimizar possíveis interrupções, violações de dados, não conformidade, penalidades financeiras ou impactos na marca e/ou reputação;
  • Avaliar o impacto potencial dos riscos de segurança cibernética nos processos e funções críticas do negócio;
  • Avaliar a relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação às possíveis perdas, ponderando as despesas com a implementação de controles de segurança em relação ao impacto financeiro e operacional de um incidente de segurança, otimizando a alocação de recursos para alcançar a máxima eficiência na redução de risco;
  • Alinhar a gestão de riscos cibernéticos com os objetivos do negócio, compreendendo os objetivos estratégicos e garantindo que as medidas de segurança cibernética sejam integradas de forma harmoniosa;
  • Coordenar a identificação e classificação dos riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e os impactos desses riscos;
  • Coordenar a coleta de dados de avaliação de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e realizar avaliações de riscos de segurança cibernética para terceiros críticos, conforme necessário;
  • Implementar e evoluir com o sistema de monitoramento e gerenciamento de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros, conforme definido nos contratos com terceiros e de acordo com Política de Segurança da Informação para Fornecedores;
  • Construir planos de remediação, colaborando com as demais lideranças da empresa para alcançar um equilíbrio entre os requisitos de segurança e a necessidade de agilidade, inovação e crescimento do negócio, assegurando que as ferramentas de segurança ou outros controles compensatórios sugeridos reduzam o risco identificado para um nível aceitável;
  • Fornecer treinamento/orientação às partes interessadas em toda a Globo para promover uma forte cultura de conscientização sobre riscos.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Bacharelado em: Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em auditoria de TI, gestão de riscos corporativos (ERM) ou gestão de riscos cibernéticos;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em identificar e avaliar riscos para os negócios da organização, estruturas de gestão de riscos e estruturas de gestão de segurança da informação, com foco na priorização de esforços para proteger aspectos vitais e minimizar interrupções;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos dos padrões de segurança cibernética, incluindo, mas não se limitando ISO 27005, OpenFAIR, NIST RMF, IRAM, TOGAF, NIST CSF e ISO/IEC 27001;
  • Histórico comprovado na realização de Análises de Custo-Benefício de Medidas de Segurança, incluindo a avaliação da relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação a potenciais perdas comerciais;
  • Experiência com princípios e práticas de segurança cibernética, incluindo gerenciamento de riscos, controles de segurança e continuidade de negócios, entre eles a ISO 22301, Práticas Profissionais do Disaster Recovery Institute (DRI) e a elaboração de Análise de Impacto no Negócio (BIA);
  • Experiência comprovada na integração da gestão de riscos de segurança cibernética com a estratégia geral de negócios, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Experiência com auditorias de conformidade, segurança e planos de mitigação de riscos;
  • Amplo conhecimento dos conceitos de gestão de riscos e governança de segurança cibernética de terceiros;
  • Experiência na avaliação de riscos de terceiros, condução e resposta a procedimentos de due dilligence e na criação de questionários para avaliação de riscos cibernético de terceiros para terceiros empresariais;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar efetivamente os outros, modificando opiniões, planos ou comportamentos de forma estruturada e eficiente com base nos dados e fatos analisados;
  • Domínio de técnicas de apresentação, possibilitando a construção de narrativas e histórias através de apresentações;
  • Experiência em influenciar terceiros e gerenciar relacionamentos com terceiros;
  • Conhecimento de métodos analíticos e proficiência em análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias e ferramentas (por exemplo: serviços de classificação financeira, serviços de classificação de segurança, plataformas integradas de gerenciamento de risco, plataformas de gerenciamento de risco de terceiros, etc.) que auxiliarão na avaliação do risco financeiro e operacional associado a fornecedores atuais e potenciais.
Conhecimentos que te destacam
  • Certificações de gestão de riscos e segurança da informação como: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA) ou Open FAIR Part-1.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Coun
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in-house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers' compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in-house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in-house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy.

The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment-related and labor-related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in-house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in-house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters.

Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership.

The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective-bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi-legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed.

Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers.

Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions.

Responds to University officials' request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility.

Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University.

Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems.

Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action.

Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures.

Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies.

Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics.

Ability to participate effectively in fact-finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations.

Ability to articulate the University's position, listen and negotiate effectively.

Superior verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision.

Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines.

Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction.

Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience.

All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range DisclosureSalary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

title: Data Architect (Database Administration & Optimization)
description:
You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.
Additional Information About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.
Nature And Scope
  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: While the Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, they are expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless research administration operations. In the absence of the Senior Director of the Incoming team, the Senior Director of the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards and agreements to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.
Principal Accountabilities
  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.
    • Implements workflow improvements and efficiency strategies to strengthen proposal development, intake quality, and routing discipline.
    • Establishes and enforces best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for proposal development, submission, and outgoing agreement processing.
    • Monitors aging actions and escalates items at risk of deadline or compliance exposure, maintaining visibility into workload distribution and backlog status.
    • Serves as a liaison between faculty, research centers, and sponsors, ensuring successful proposal submission.
  • Proposal Development & Compliance
    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including but not limited to pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.
    • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal research regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.
    • Provides consultation and guidance to Principal Investigators (PIs) on proposal requirements and submission processes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
    • Tracks proposal volume, success rates, sponsor trends, turnaround times, and backlog aging, using data to drive strategic and operational improvements.
    • Implements research analytics tools to measure performance and optimize pre-award workflows.
    • Provides regular reports to the AVP of Sponsored Programs on proposal activity, funding trends, operational efficiency, and documentation quality.
  • Strategic Process Leadership
    • Leads process design, policy implementation, and operational strengthening across the outgoing pre-award function.
    • Engages in strategic discussions with the AVP and Senior Director (Incoming team) on research administration improvements and institutional priorities.
    • Identifies and addresses systemic workflow gaps, documentation risks, and handoff failures to ensure audit-ready operations.
Core Competencies
  • Leadership & Team Management: Ability to supervise, train, and develop pre-award staff; set priorities; redistribute work during absences; and maintain team stability in a high-volume environment.
  • Expertise in Federal Funding & Compliance: Deep knowledge of NIH, NSF, DoD, and foundation grants, including federal compliance regulations.
  • Proposal Development & Strategy: Strong understanding of sponsor priorities, funding trends, and proposal submission requirements.
  • Operational Process Design: Ability to build, document, and enforce repeatable workflows and SOPs that support consistent, compliant operations.
  • Data Analytics & Process Improvement: Ability to track, analyze, and optimize pre-award workflows and research funding success rates.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Skilled in collaborating with faculty, administrators, legal, compliance, and external sponsors to facilitate research success.
  • Contract & Agreement Oversight: Ability to review and sign standard proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, with the judgment to elevate complex cases appropriately.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Extensive experience in grant and contract administration is essential and will carry more weight than advanced credentials.
  • 8+ years of experience in research administration, with at least 5 years in leadership roles, preferably within a central research administration office.
  • Leadership experience is crucial, particularly in guiding and stabilizing a team dedicated to contract and agreement administration.
  • Exceptional organizational skills are a must, with the capacity to handle multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the entire lifecycle of research award administration, from the proposal phase to the award set-up.
  • Experience with outgoing subaward and consultant agreement administration, including subrecipient monitoring and risk documentation.
  • Must possess a deep understanding of federal contract requirements.
  • Comprehensive grasp of federal research compliance regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Proficiency with enterprise research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday, or similar platforms).

Expected Pay Range: $145,454 - $160,000

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (NGL) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

You will be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie") , one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.

Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.

The Mission

Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.

This role is measured in metrics shipped , not features shipped.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

This role reports directly to the General Manager – NGL and operates as the single‑threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross‑functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data , and you will own feature rollout end‑to‑end in partnership with Engineering.

What You’ll Do
  • Monetization Systems
    • You own all product‑led revenue systems:
    • Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
    • Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
    • One‑time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
    • Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
    • Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
    • Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
    • Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
  • You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
  • NGL is creator‑driven. You own:
  • Influencer onboarding flows
  • Creator‑specific product surfaces and incentives
  • Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
  • Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
  • Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel. Funnel Ownership (End‑to‑End)
  • You own the full lifecycle:
  • Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
  • First‑session experience and activation
  • Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
  • Re‑engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
  • Conversion to paid
  • Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
  • Retention, churn reduction, and win‑back flows
You are expected to know where every drop‑off lives. Experimentation & Growth Velocity
  • You will:
  • Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
  • Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
  • Test influencer‑specific monetization strategies
  • Kill underperforming ideas quickly
  • Scale winners aggressively
  • K‑Factor Optimization
Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection. Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
  • You own feature execution end‑to‑end:
  • Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
  • Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
  • Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
  • Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
  • Monitor post‑launch performance and iterate fast
You ship, measure, and refine. No throw‑it‑over‑the‑wall handoffs. Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
  • You will:
  • Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
  • Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
  • Revenue performance
  • Funnel metrics
  • Experiment results
  • Key risks and opportunities
  • Provide data‑backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
The GM should never be surprised by the numbers Success in This Role Means
  • You are directly accountable for:
  • Paid conversion rate
  • ARPU / LTV
  • D7 / D30 retention
  • Revenue by acquisition source
  • LTV / CAC and payback period
  • Experiment velocity
What You Bring to the Team
  • 5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
  • Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
  • Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one‑time purchases
  • Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
  • Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
  • Proven track record running high‑velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
  • Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end‑to‑end
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
  • Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
  • A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
  • Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
  • Experience in creator‑driven or social products preferred
  • Experience optimizing K‑Factor and viral loops preferred
  • Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.
Why Join Mode Mobile
  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic . Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people – collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
  • Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
  • Work with a global, top‑tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
  • Shape the next stage of a high‑growth social platform , entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Riscos Cibernéticos | Segurança da Informação
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Compreender como os diferentes riscos cibernéticos podem afetar as operações da Globo, priorizando os esforços para proteger os aspectos mais vitais do negócio e minimizar possíveis interrupções, violações de dados, não conformidade, penalidades financeiras ou impactos na marca e/ou reputação;
  • Avaliar o impacto potencial dos riscos de segurança cibernética nos processos e funções críticas do negócio;
  • Avaliar a relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação as possíveis perdas, ponderando as despesas com a implementação de controles de segurança em relação ao impacto financeiro e operacional de um incidente de segurança, otimizando a alocação de recursos para alcançar a máxima eficiência na redução de risco;
  • Alinhar a gestão de riscos cibernéticos com os objetivos do negócio, compreendendo os objetivos estratégicos e garantindo que as medidas de segurança cibernética sejam integradas de forma harmoniosa;
  • Coordenar a identificação e classificação dos riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e os impactos desses riscos;
  • Coordenar a coleta de dados de avaliação de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e realizar avaliações de riscos de segurança cibernética para terceiros críticos, conforme necessário;
  • Implementar e evoluir com o sistema de monitoramento e gerenciamento de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros, conforme definido nos contratos com terceiros e de acordo com Política de Segurança da Informação para Fornecedores;
  • Construir planos de remediação, colaborando com as demais lideranças da empresa para alcançar um equilíbrio entre os requisitos de segurança e a necessidade de agilidade, inovação e crescimento do negócio, assegurando que as ferramentas de segurança ou outros controles compensatórios sugeridos reduzam o risco identificado para um nível aceitável;
  • Fornecer treinamento/orientação às partes interessadas em toda a Globo para promover uma forte cultura de conscientização sobre riscos.
Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Bacharelado em: Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em auditoria de TI, gestão de riscos corporativos (ERM) ou gestão de riscos cibernéticos;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em identificar e avaliar riscos para os negócios da organização, estruturas de gestão de riscos e estruturas de gestão de segurança da informação, com foco na priorização de esforços para proteger aspectos vitais e minimizar interrupções;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos dos padrões de segurança cibernética, incluindo, mas não se limitando ISO 27005, OpenFAIR, NIST RMF, IRAM, TOGAF, NIST CSF e ISO/IEC 27001;
  • Histórico comprovado na realização de Análises de Custo-Benefício de Medidas de Segurança, incluindo a avaliação da relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação a potenciais perdas comerciais.
  • Experiência com princípios e práticas de segurança cibernética, incluindo gerenciamento de riscos, controles de segurança e continuidade de negócios, entre eles a ISO 22301, Práticas Profissionais do Disaster Recovery Institute (DRI) e a elaboração de Análise de Impacto no Negócio (BIA);
  • Experiência comprovada na integração da gestão de riscos de segurança cibernética com a estratégia geral de negócios, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Experiência com auditorias de conformidade, segurança e planos de mitigação de riscos;
  • Amplo conhecimento dos conceitos de gestão de riscos e governança de segurança cibernética de terceiros;
  • Experiência na avaliação de riscos de terceiros, condução e resposta a procedimentos de due diligence e na criação de questionários para avaliação de riscos cibernéticos de terceiros para terceiros empresariais;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar efetivamente os outros, modificando opiniões, planos ou comportamentos de forma estruturada e eficiente com base nos dados e fatos analisados;
  • Domínio de técnicas de apresentação, possibilitando a construção de narrativas e histórias através de apresentações;
