title: Especialista Em Design De Calçados
description: Especialista em Design de Calçados Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ I. A Missão da Posição O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time. II. Responsabilidades Principais Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados. Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance. Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce. Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio. Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca. Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos. III. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios. Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes. Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores. Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado. Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas. IV. Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure. Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design. Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento. Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Global Networks Leader
description: Purpose As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services. Main Responsibilities Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance. Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations. Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets. Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices. Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making. Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions. Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements. Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits. Knowledge and experience requiered Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools. Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS. Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control. Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment. Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.G., Ansible, Python). Management & communication Skills Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers. Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.G., operations, finance, senior management). Relevant Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations. Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners. Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable. ITIL certification is a plus.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLEWe are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSIONAt Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Head Of Legal
description:

We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive;
the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page hereAbout the RoleWe are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets, requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. investor relations from a legal standpoint- Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructureYou can be a Rock-Star if you haveCore Skills & Experience- Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)- 8–15+ years of experience, ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors- Proven experience in:- Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle- Due diligence (legal & regulatory)- Complex contract structuring and negotiation- International contracts and cross-border operations- Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.G., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)- Solid experience with:- Corporate law and governance- Investor relations and strategic partnerships- Fluency in English, with experience working in international environmentsKey Qualities- Business-oriented mindset: understands legal as a driver of growth- Highly relational: strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions- Strategic thinker: connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks- Pragmatic and solution-driven: balances risk with execution speed- High ownership: comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure- Strong institutional presence: capable of representing the company externally- Structured and integrative: able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains- Neutral and sound judgment, especially in complex or sensitive mattersBonus Points (but not essential)- Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets- Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms- Exposure to governance and international structures- Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)- Business and legal experience in Germany- Speaks German- Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SPLiving Our ValuesAt InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.7. definição e implementação de estratégias de mitigação de riscos.- Adaptabilidade: atualização constante frente à evolução das leis e regulamentos;
desenvolvimento de soluções jurídicas e contratuais inovadoras para atender às necessidades da afiliada.- Colaboração e resiliência: postura colaborativa, resiliência, persistência e estilo pragmático/criativo de assessoria jurídica.- Ética: elevados padrões éticos.Experiência profissional: mínimo de 10 anos de experiência jurídica, majoritariamente na indústria de Óleo e Gás (Upstream).#J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension) Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Técnico De Serviços Em Maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito. A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês. Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo: Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado. Tipos de equipamentos atendidos: - Radares - ECDIS - Satcoms - Rádios HF e VHF - GPS - Girobússola - Pilotos automáticos - Sirenes Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima: - Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.
- Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.
- Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
- Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.
- Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.
- Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima. Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Language Specialist
description: Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer) Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil) About the Role: As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). Key Responsibilities: Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance. Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies. Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains. Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks. Qualifications: Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills. Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred. Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail. Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.

title: Analista Administrativo De Obras
description:
A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela. Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Administrativo de Obra (Financeiro) para atuar em nossa obra, um projeto com alto volume de controle e exigência de detalhamento junto ao cliente. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), organizado(a) e com atenção aos detalhes, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos administrativos e financeiros da obra. Principais atividades da função: .Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;
.Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;
.Verificar se as retenções de impostos (PCC, IR, INSS) estão de acordo com o ensinado e devolver ao fornecedor quando houver divergências;
.Verificar o CNAE na nota fiscal do fornecedor, assegurando que esteja compatível com o serviço prestado;
.Conferir o endereço da obra nas notas fiscais, garantindo que esteja conforme o solicitado pelo cliente;
.Cobrar as apropriações da engenharia para lançamento das APs e controle financeiro;
.Emitir e conferir relatórios de pedidos de compra em aberto, boletins de medição e saldos de contratos, cobrando notas fiscais correspondentes;
.Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;
.Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;
.Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;
.Emitir e conferir relatório “Administração de Obras”, montar RP e enviar ao financeiro corporativo com as notas e documentos exigidos pelo cliente;
.Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;
.Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;
.Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;
.No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;
.Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia. Pré-requisitos: .Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;
.Experiência anteriorem rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;
.Excel intermediário ou avançado;
.Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;
.Facilidade decomunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas. Desejável: .Conhecimento em Sienge;
.Experiência em obrascom múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;
.Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;
.Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira. Outras informações: .Regime: CLT .Carga Horária: 44 horas semanais - Presencial (segunda a sexta-feira) .Local: Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro .Benefícios: vale assiduidade, plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e vale-transporte

Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios. O Bureau Veritas estáem conformidade com a Constituição Federal brasileira (no inc. V do seu art. 5o.Inc. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: Implementation Analyst
description: Job Title: Implementation Analyst English Resume Only Location: Brazil Type: Full-Time Contract Setup: Fully Remote Level: Mid-Level Industry: Software SAAS Company Shift: US Hours Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer Equipment: Available upon request Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000 About The Methodical Group The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.Com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge. About the Opportunity Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption. The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience. Responsibilities Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients. Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations. Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability. Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live. Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments. Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health. Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability. Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch. Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles. Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams. Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms. Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously. Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Analista De Negócios Em Rh
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG. Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Principais atividades: Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR) Conhecimento específicos: Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

- Busquem consciênciasocial de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem eantecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executemo trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementemnovas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada! Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória. Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site: O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

title: Vaga:Psicólogo Clínico Trainee | Clínica Ft
description: Processo Seletivo | Psicólogo Clínico Trainee | Clínica FTDescrição da vagaA Clínica Flávio Torrecillas nasceu de uma convicção simples: a psicologia formou muitos profissionais para atender, mas poucos para sustentar clínica, postura, carreira e independência no mundo real. Durante anos, vimos de perto o mesmo padrão se repetir: psicólogos tecnicamente bons, mas inseguros na condução clínica, frágeis na construção da própria carreira e presos a um modelo de profissão que cobra muito, devolve pouco e quase sempre empurra o profissional para o improviso. Foi por isso que a Clínica FT decidiu construir a formação e a oportunidade que eu queria ter tido : um modelo diferente e mais real. Mais do que uma clínica, desenvolvemos um ambiente de formação aplicada para psicólogos que desejam crescer com profundidade, supervisão, direção e responsabilidade. Aqui, o profissional não entra apenas para atender. Ele entra para aprender a sustentar uma prática clínica mais madura, mais estruturada e mais coerente com a realidade da profissão.Nosso modelo combina atendimento real, supervisão clínica, mentoria profissional e desenvolvimento de visão de carreira. Acreditamos que psicólogo não deve ser formado apenas para sobreviver de sessão em sessão, mas para construir presença, clareza, valor e autonomia ao longo do tempo.Por isso, a Clínica FT busca profissionais e futuros profissionais que queiram mais do que uma contratação. Buscamos pessoas que queiram fazer parte de uma formação viva, exigente e transformadora, dentro de uma estrutura que leva a sério tanto o cuidado com o paciente quanto a construção do psicólogo que sustenta esse cuidado. Eu vou te ensinar o passo a passo de como ser um psicólogo mais seguro para atender seus pacientes e toda a abrir as portas de toda a estrutura que trouxe ate aqui. Sobre a oportunidadeSe você está cansado de ser só mais um na psicologia, de esperar paciente cair do céu, sente vergonha de cobrar, depende de indicação ou já cansou de não ter paciente?Aqui você vai aprender tudo que ninguém te ensinou, direto com Flávio Torrecillas, eleito psicólogo destaque de MG por 3 anos consecutivos, portador do título “Gente de Expressão de MG” 30 mil atendimentos realizados e fundador da Clínica FT.Esta oportunidade foi pensada para psicólogos e estudantes em fase avançada da graduação que desejam desenvolver segurança clínica, visão de carreira e prática supervisionada dentro de uma estrutura profissionalO que você vai viver em 6 meses comigo:Aprender a captar paciente de verdade (sem depender de sorte)Dominar o marketing que gera autoridade clínica e agenda cheiaVender e cobrar com ética, sem vergonha ou trava de inicianteCriar sua marca pessoal e saber se posicionar pra nunca mais ser só “mais um”Gestão de clínica-empresa, postura profissional e visão empreendedoraAcesso ao bastidor real, sem autoajuda fácil ou papo de guruResponsabilidadesrealizar atendimentos psicológicos dentro do modelo de funcionamento da Clínica FTparticipar das title: Hr And Recruitment Specialist (Americas Timezone)
description: About Reboot MonkeyReboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents. We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We're a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet.About the RoleWe will be direct with you: we have cycled through 84 people in approximately 2 years. Your job is to break that pattern. We are not looking for someone to post jobs and schedule interviews. We need someone who can look at that number — 84 churned in 24 months — and build the structured process that makes it stop. That means quality-over-quantity sourcing, structured interviews with consistent scoring, onboarding that actually prepares people to work, and early performance signal tracking that catches a bad fit in week 2, not week 8.This role is critical to everything else we are trying to build. Without a functioning hiring pipeline, we cannot staff the operations, sales, and finance functions that the company needs to grow. You own that pipeline. Why LATAM?We are building a 24/7 recruitment operation. With our existing team spread across CET and APAC timezones, we need recruitment coverage in the Americas timezone (UTC-3 to UTC-5) to ensure candidates are being sourced, screened, and moved through the pipeline around the clock. Brazil and Argentina are our priority markets for this role due to strong talent pools, timezone alignment, and cultural fit with our global remote team. Day-to-day you will:Manage the full hiring pipeline for all open roles in Recruitee — from sourcing to offerWrite and post job descriptions in Recruitee (you will improve on the ones we already have)Screen CVs against role requirements — moving qualified candidates forward, rejecting unqualified ones fastConduct first-stage screening calls to assess fit, availability, and English fluencyCoordinate trial tasks with candidates and score results against the rubricOwn onboarding for every new hire: send access credentials, set up their first-week schedule, run the 30-minute orientation callTrack hiring pipeline metrics weekly: candidates screened, interviews scheduled, time-to-fill per roleReport to Michel (CEO) weekly with a pipeline updateProvide Americas-timezone recruitment coverage as part of our 24/7 hiring operation Over time: build and maintain an onboarding playbook so the process is consistent regardless of roleWhat You'll Own (KPIs)These are your KPIs. Shared upfront, reviewed every 2 weeks for the first 3 months, then monthly:Candidates screened: 20+ per week during active hiring phases Interview-to-hire ratio: 5:1 or better (5 interviews for every hire made) Time-to-fill: 21 days or less from job posting to offer accepted, per role Onboarding completion: 100% of new hires complete the onboarding checklist before their second week Weekly pipeline report: Delivered every Friday by EOD The primary metric is time-to-fill. Every day a critical role is unfilled is a day the CEO absorbs that work. Speed with quality is the target. Compensation and Terms Monthly retainer: EUR 600–800 depending on experience (competitive for LATAM market) Arrangement: Freelance / contractor — you invoice us monthly Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week Performance reviews: Every 2 weeks for the first 3 months, then monthly

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets. Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
